title: Hosted API location commitments and audit orchestration
creator: Renee Park
description: Define and ship a Hosted API feature set that allows tenants to declare location commitments (region affinities and hard/soft pin modes), configure retention profiles per commitment, and automatically produce machine-readable attestation bundles for audits. This ticket covers product requirements, operator UX in Console, API surface for tenant pin enrollment, evidence packaging format, rollout policy for soft-failover vs hard-lock, and the acceptance criteria for compliance customers.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant can create/update a location commitment via Console and API with: regions list, pin mode (hard|soft|preferred), retention profile, and optional SLA override justification

Runtime enforces requests according to the pin mode: hard = reject out-of-region execution; soft = prefer local region but allow routed failover with logged exception; preferred = advisory routing only
Retention profiles are attached to commitments and applied to request/response store and evidence exports
Automated attestation bundles (JSON + signed manifest) generated daily and on-demand for a tenant, containing request-location hashes, routing decisions, and retention snapshots
Console exposes per-tenant audit timeline, evidence download, and an evidence-synthesis job status with links to exported artifacts
End-to-end tests validate enforcement and evidence integrity; legal/compliance sign-off on attestation schema
Feature flag gated rollout with canary for low-impact customers, metrics and SLOs instrumented for routing failures and evidence generation success rate

implementation_notes: Backend: routing policy engine extension, retention profile store, attestation exporter service. Console: commitment CRUD flows, audit timeline, evidence download flow. SDK/API: new endpoints tenants.commitments.create/update/list and tenants.attestations.generate. Feature flag: residency.commitments.v1
risks_and_tradeoffs: Hard-locking increases compliance guarantees but raises availability risk in cross-region outages. Soft mode reduces outages but complicates audit narratives. Attestation export cadence affects storage/costs and timeliness for auditors. We'll default new tenants to 'soft-preferred' with a clear escalation path for compliance contracts.
test_plan: Unit tests for routing decision matrix, integration tests simulating region outage and validating fallback behavior, contract tests for attestation schema (signature verification + manifest fields), e2e runbook for compliance reviewers to validate evidence bundles.
